entities.summary: Murong Sheng, courtesy name Daoyun, also known by his posthumous name as the Emperor Zhaowu of Later Yan, was an emperor of the Xianbei-led Later Yan dynasty of China. He was the oldest son of Murong Bao, and after Murong Bao was killed by Lan Han avenged his father in a coup and took the throne. During his final years, he demoted himself from Emperor and used the unique title of "Heavenly King of the common people".
